module_role: Source-list ownership ledger for the explicitly printed M4.0 VFD and M4.1 chiller integration lists. It preserves list scope without inventing an installed terminal count, controller wiring assignment, or unprinted AI/AO/DI/DO type.
source_points_composite: The points bundle component is controls_context_m4, whose three exact tables retain the VFD, chiller, and all-compressor-circuit source-list rows.
ownership_binding_semantics: ownership_scope identifies the printed interface/system scope only. It does not create a physical field-device owner or multiply the open-ended list by an assumed equipment quantity.
expanded_count_warning: The ledger contains 16 printed source-list rows. The two printed lists use NOT BE LIMITED TO / ALL AVAILABLE language, so 16 is not a complete installed BAS point or terminal count.

applications.ownership_scope: M4.1 all-compressor-circuits sublist in chiller integration module

installed_IO_total.reason: No terminal plan, controller panel schedule, type-coded point matrix, or complete vendor integration export is supplied. The source lists are expressly open-ended.

point_transport.note: The controls source prints BACnet and existing Delta-system context, but no list row is assigned a network transport or field wiring method.
